observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -30
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    ctx=b.new_context(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg=ctx.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    print("URL:",pg.url,"| judul:",pg.title()[:60])
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:500].replace("\n"," | "))
    for sel in ["a[href*=login]","a[href*=sign-up]","button"]:
        print(sel,"->",pg.locator(sel).count())
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/kg1.png")
    b.close()
PY
